title: 4 April 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
content:
The Beatles’ 66th evening show at the Cavern Club took place on this date. It was also the 26th occasion on which they performed both lunchtime and evening shows at the venue.

Overall this was their 167th appearance at the underground Mathew Street venue, including their lunchtime shows.

The precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, although they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.
